عَصِيمٌ : see عُصْمٌ. ―
-b2- Also Sweat: (K:) or, accord. to Lth, rust [that is an effect] of sweat. (TA.) ―
-b3- And Dirt, and urine that dries, upon the thighs of camels, (K, TA,) so as to become like the road, in thickness. (TA.) ―
-b4- And Black hair that grows beneath the fur of the camel when it falls off (إِذَا ٱنْتَسَلَ [perhaps a mistranscription for اذا أَنْسَلَ]). (K.) ―
-b5- And The leaves of trees. (IB, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
